### Diff-aware (automatic when on a feature branch with no URL)

Read `git diff <base>...HEAD --name-only` and `git log <base>..HEAD --oneline`. Map changed routes, views, components, models and styles to pages and test them in the browser.

**No identifiable pages:** tell the user that the diff has no visible UI surface and ask, using AskUserQuestion:
- A) Run a Quick browser pass anyway: homepage + top 5 navigation targets (recommended)
- B) Skip browser testing for this branch

Follow the user's choice.
